method: Whole-file manual reading of English resource catalog; pinned bytes verified and every nonempty line parsed as key/value with unique keys.
findings: English catalog explicitly labels sampled results Probable duplicates, distinguishes Hash Prefix from Sampled hash and states sparse hashes apply above64MiB. These labels agree with earlier sampling-source review but do not establish byte equality for destructive use.

Recovery copied outcome explicitly asks users to verify file data; unallocated assessment says May Be Recoverable. Same-volume warning explains deleted-data overwrite risk. This avoids equating successful output write with historically correct recovered bytes.

Deletion confirmation asks whether to continue and warns about important files; generic operation confirmations contain operation text. Catalog text alone does not prove every handler displays or honors them.
Cloud duplicate warning says cloud files are skipped to avoid download and points to settings; skipping is part of scan scope, not evidence all files were compared.

Tier list has four nonempty English entries, confirming nonempty tiers for this catalog only. Time suffixes day/mo/yr provide the month element used in analytics; other translations remain unreviewed.

Graph styles four entries and permission-level/type/applicability lists are positional resources consumed by code. Unique-key validation does not prove all positional consumers, placeholder arity or translated catalogs correct.
MSI locale metadata declares en-US/1033/codepage1252 and installer options. Read-only catalog inspection does not qualify localization rendering or installation.
limits: No runtime resource lookup, formatting/placeholder arity tests, GUI localization, model accuracy, installer or translated-catalog semantic qualification.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred. Global completed repository count remains147/500.
